R4A-bear-backcountry-0003.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R4A-bear-backcountry-0003.parkWhat: pull off on Allendale Cres (paved road)

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2018 (8 years old), 320 m NE: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2018 (fire N52548), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
W facing slope, 18 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle for Hunting Closed Area: Rialto Creek. Closed April 1 to June 30 and September 1 to November 30. Synopsis map 2-45/23.
Route crosses provincial park: Syringa Park. Hunting only where that park allows it, in open season. Check its bcparks.ca page (synopsis page 9, 99%).
Route crosses private land (ParcelMap BC, updated 2026-10-09): get permission first or go around.

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: bag 2; private land only, with landowner permission

plan: Drive: from City of Rossland, about 32 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.34469, -117.85228, pull off on Allendale Cres (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 5.1 km N, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 1,179 m, about 219 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: no flat ground near water in the data within 1.5 km. Plan a dry camp and carry water (Tip).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-15, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4A-bear-backcountry-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-15: about 361 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.20 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
